name: Nord Frost
description: Nord (nordtheme/nord): Polar Night surfaces with the bright nord8 Frost accent — Nord's documented primary accent.
variant: Polar Night · bright nord8 Frost accent

palette_roles.nord1: Polar Night; lighter bg for UI elements like status bars
palette_roles.nord2: Polar Night; line highlight, UI selection/highlight
palette_roles.nord3: Polar Night; comments, disabled UI elements
palette_roles.nord4: Snow Storm base; main text colour
palette_roles.nord8: Frost; THE accent colour, primary UI elements, markup link URLs

ansi_source: https://github.com/nordtheme/alacritty/blob/main/src/nord.yaml ; syntax from https://github.com/nordtheme/vim (colors/nord.vim) and nordtheme/visual-studio-code (comment = nord3_gui_bright #616E88)

preview.msg5: Such calm colours for late-night chats.

notes: Accent: nord8, Nord's documented primary accent. Links can't also be nord8, so they use nord9; the two are close in hue (~17°), links are underlined.
Nord has a single dark palette. The two Nord themes share the same Polar Night surfaces and differ only in accent (user's choice).
Polar Night's darkest colour is nord0, so tertiary = main (nord0); PRIMARY_700/800 both nord0.
Floating surfaces use nord2 (documented UI highlight colour) so sheets stand out from nord1 panels.
Derived: text_secondary / text_muted / interactive_muted are mixes of nord4 and nord3. nord3 (documented comment/disabled colour) is ~1.6:1 on nord0, unusable as text.
Derived: danger is nord11 lightened 25% toward nord6 — nord11 itself is ~2.9:1 on nord0, too low even for status text.
